problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 \\ 10 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

A triangle $S$ has vertices at $(-2,1),(0,0)$ and $(2,2)$ Which of the following are coordinates of the vertices of ${S}^{′},$ the image of $S$ under the action of $T?$  

- $(6,-18)$
- $(-5,-20)$
- $(12,-24)$

Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Which of the following is the image of the triangle shown above under the action of $T?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the image of the triangle under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of the triangle:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & -1 \\ 2 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & -1 \\ 2 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 & -2 \\ 2 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the image's vertices are $(-2,2)$, $(1,-1)$,  and $(-2,2).$ Notice that all three points lie on the same line.
